crossRefs.note: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against…

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Gibeah
people.line: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
translations.bsb: On the third day the Israelites went up against the Benjamites and arrayed themselves against Gibeah as they had done before.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.
